paragraphs: Inspect declared write authority and its original executable controls. Ownership declarations do not show which paths a run actually read or wrote.
The active run is unchanged. These controls execute in a separate fixture with fresh occurrence allocation.
Membership markers address canonical set members. They do not turn the persisted domain set into a map. Counters and resolution history cannot be removed.
Changed model identity records a definition change; it does not alone prove different behavior. Codec round trips and native scheduler save/load are separate checks.

Original eight semantic state-authority tests execute in original order with a fresh per-invocation ordinal map. Seven writable leaves across roots241..244, exact ownership refusals, canonical-set membership projection, codec round-trip, removal/value grammar and ModelIdentity distinctions. Codec persistence is not native scheduler save/load. Model-identity differences do not alone prove changed runtime behavior. Declared authority is not an observed read/write participation trace. Assertion operands and caught errors are retained, not every execution input. No UI, full SEM or Campaign4 qualification.
